461: \subsection{O PsiBit e a assinatura como propriedade espectral}
462: O PsiBit preserva \emph{dois sinais}: $(\mathrm{sign}\,L,\ \mathrm{sign}\,
463: \partial L)$ --- paridade (espacial, reversível) e direção do fluxo (temporal,
464: irreversível). \emph{Sem valor absoluto.} A assinatura lorentziana é
465: propriedade espectral, não subtração de tensores:
466: \begin{equation}
467: \boxed{\;\mathrm{sign}(g)=(-,+,+,+)\;}\quad\text{com}\quad
468: g(v_t,v_t)<0,\ \ g(v_i,v_i)>0,
469: \end{equation}
470: onde o \emph{autovetor de autovalor negativo} ($v_t$) é a direção
471: irreversível. \textbf{Correção registrada (\REF):} a forma $g=g^{(+)}-g^{(-)}$
472: (subtração de tensores) é incorreta; a assinatura é o sinal dos autovalores
473: da \emph{mesma} métrica.

30: def SoundRule {Y : Type u} {O : Type v} (reading : Y → O) (target : O)

137:   · intro hy
138:     cases hy
139:     exact h0

35: def spectralDistance (t : ℝ) (u v : ℕ → Bool) : ℝ :=
36:   |geometricLogReading t u-geometricLogReading t v|
37: 
38: theorem spectral_distance_nonnegative (t : ℝ) (u v : ℕ → Bool) :
39:     0 ≤ spectralDistance t u v := abs_nonneg _
40: 
41: theorem spectral_distance_self (t : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Bool) :
42:     spectralDistance t u u=0 := by simp [spectralDistance]
43: 
44: theorem spectral_distance_symmetric (t : ℝ) (u v : ℕ → Bool) :
45:     spectralDistance t u v=spectralDistance t v u := abs_sub_comm _ _
46: 
47: theorem spectral_distance_triangle (t : ℝ) (u v w : ℕ → Bool) :
48:     spectralDistance t u w  ≤  spectralDistance t u v+spectralDistance t v w :=
49:   abs_sub_le _ _ _
50: 
51: theorem spectral_distance_zero_iff {t : ℝ} (ht : t≠0) (u v : ℕ → Bool) :
52:     spectralDistance t u v=0 ↔ u=v := by
53:   rw [spectralDistance,abs_eq_zero,sub_eq_zero]
54:   exact (geometric_log_reading_injective ht).eq_iff
55: 
56: theorem spectral_distance_positive {t : ℝ} (ht : t≠0)
57:     {u v : ℕ → Bool} (h : u≠v) : 0<spectralDistance t u v :=
58:   lt_of_le_of_ne (spectral_distance_nonnegative t u v)
59:     (Ne.symm (fun hz => h ((spectral_distance_zero_iff ht u v).mp hz)))
60: 
61: def scaledSpectralDistance (c t : ℝ) (u v : ℕ → Bool) : ℝ :=
62:   c*spectralDistance t u v
63: 
64: theorem scaled_spectral_distance_triangle {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
65:     (t : ℝ) (u v w : ℕ → Bool) :
66:     scaledSpectralDistance c t u w  ≤ 
67:       scaledSpectralDistance c t u v+scaledSpectralDistance c t v w := by
68:   have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (spectral_distance_triangle t u v w) hc
69:   simpa only [scaledSpectralDistance,mul_add] using h
70: 
71: theorem scaled_spectral_distance_zero_iff {c t : ℝ} (hc : 0<c) (ht : t≠0)
72:     (u v : ℕ → Bool) :
73:     scaledSpectralDistance c t u v=0 ↔ u=v := by
74:   rw [scaledSpectralDistance,mul_eq_zero]
75:   simp only [ne_of_gt hc,false_or,spectral_distance_zero_iff ht]
76: 
77: theorem different_scales_give_different_distances {c d t : ℝ}
78:     (hcd : c≠d) (ht : t≠0) {u v : ℕ → Bool} (huv : u≠v) :
79:     scaledSpectralDistance c t u v ≠ scaledSpectralDistance d t u v := by
80:   intro he
81:   have hn : spectralDistance t u v≠0 := ne_of_gt (spectral_distance_positive ht huv)
82:   exact hcd (mul_right_cancel₀ hn he)
